digest.component_or_area: development process audit evaluation and disposition
propositions: Escaped-defect metadata captured via optional detected_by field at creation seam achieves only 1.1% coverage; expand automatic stamping at known automated-filer boundaries without global requirement or backfill.

Deterministic plan preflight floor at P1-P11 blocks only sound mechanical conditions; extend only for recurrent failures demonstrated in persisted review data with offline replay, false-positive ceiling, and fail-open behavior.

Completion first-non-PASS outcomes mix code defects, unmet ACs, missing evidence, scope gaps, and environment failures; classify historical sidecars offline before adding schema to avoid invalid escaped-defect attribution.

Risk-tiered review lacks reliable escaped-defect denominator and actual-diff calibration; pilot signals (security surfaces, module complexity, plan failures) with independent model review and property tests before enforcement.
Non-blocking module-size warning at 720 LOC has shipped; do not adopt arbitrary quota targets; prioritize debt only where headroom intersects complexity, churn, defects, or centrality.

Autonomous contribution process contains no human review gate; focus remaining governance work on auditable author-model versus reviewer-model independence, provider diversity, and force-override frequency measurement.
